This describes no independently supported security regression, but the source and patch are not replayed: integration_source omits both reviewed source units, so those line references and surrounding controls cannot be verified here.
The material unresolved contract is how stopStringScope is produced and consumed by translation. Further review must verify that it preserves stop behavior and does not replace or weaken coordinator-authenticated account/model/prompt-contract cache isolation, incompatible-checkpoint rejection, or cancellation/resource cleanup (T-041, T-010; TB-007, A-001, A-018). The supplied summary reports no changes to encryption, authorization, attestation, billing, or persistent cache metadata; this is not independent source evidence establishing those conclusions. No finding is justified solely by missing translation/caller evidence. Integration needs the omitted bridge source and the relevant changed translation/scope plumbing to resolve this PR-specific uncertainty.
